sections.title: Hotfix Balance Update
sections.description: This is a hero balance hotfix. Replay codes from the February 4, 2025 patch are still available.

blocks.title: Heroes
blocks.body: Mercy (Overwatch Classic - Moth Meta) Guardian Angel has been updated to have increased speed and range during Valkyrie. Mercy's resurrect cast time has been improved.
blocks.dev: Developer Comment: We have made some adjustments to Mercy's abilities to be more like the original feel of the hero in 2017. Additionally, we're planning an update to Doomfist in the mode in the next patch.
